mergedWhy: Moved (1200): the type is answered on the one page (qtools.js qtRow_), marked by its checker's one marker (find-marking.js mark_, or the pen's DRAW_MARK), its differences data on its QTYPE_PROTOCOL row (keys); check-qmerge.js proves the marks unchanged. coords is a typed pair marked by markAnswer_ (number); hand is drawn (points). table, match and label (cells) and essay (AI only) are not yet.
why: The universal question page (roadmap 7, 920): each qtype's shared checker, and whether it has moved onto the one page. Move a type by setting moved: true once its answer check proves the batch.
answer_why: Every part is answered in one typed box, plus a photo of working where needed (owner, 9 Nov); a drawing stays only where the answer IS a drawing. Marked by mark_ (find-marking.js), one engine: exact keys, then mechanical rules; never AI.
rowWhy: The tools every question part shows, identically, in this order (owner, 8 Nov), Calculator only where the paper allows one, Make available offline only signed in (owner, 11 Nov); js/qtools.js reads it as QT_ROW.
phrasesWhy: Words several types share, written once: a type's field that is or starts with `{name}` reads that phrase (qtypes.js qtPhrase_).

phrases.typed: One box on the site's keypad
phrases.pen: Its figure under the pen, in place on the card: its own, or the stem's (the stem's words carried onto the card above it), else a made-up grid. One figure, no second copy, no Draw switch, no box or keypad; Check under the part's words
phrases.penPhone: Finger draws, two fingers pan; the loupe follows the finger
phrases.penPc: Mouse or stylus on a lazy brush (368); the ruler snaps to the grid

typesWhy: THE ONE LIST OF QUESTION TYPES (owner, 17 Nov): each type's checker, whether it has moved onto the one page, and its protocol — what the part looks like (surface, tiles), how it is marked and how wrong and right read, its keypad layer, and `need`, what makes a row complete (a field, `a|b` either one, or a named test, qtypes.js QT_NEED). js/qtypes.js reads it as QTYPE_PROTOCOL.

value.label: Single value
value.marked: accept: the number by value, a band `a to b`, a name in front (`x = 9`) allowed
value.tolerance: as the scheme writes it; a band where it prints one

unit.label: Value with a unit
unit.surface: {typed}, maths keys with the unit row
unit.marked: accept: the number, its unit optional unless the scheme needs it (√, π, a rate)
unit.tolerance: cm2 = cm² = cm^2; a wrong unit is wrong

fraction.label: Fraction or mixed number
fraction.marked: accept by value (2/5 = 6/15 = 0.4); `rule: mixed` when the form is asked
fraction.tolerance: equal value unless simplest/mixed form is asked

multi.label: Several values
multi.surface: One box (owner, 20 Nov): the values typed in it with commas or spaces
multi.marked: accept list as a set, or `rule:` clauses (count, each, sum, set …)

measure.label: Measure from a figure
measure.surface: {typed} beside the figure; a protractor or ruler laid on the figure (385)
measure.marked: accept as a band (`a to b`); an angle survives the screen, a length needs a stated scale
measure.phone: One finger drags the tool, two turn it, or its round handle; it snaps onto a corner and along an arm
measure.pc: Drag; the handle or the wheel turns it; typed

expr.label: Expression or equation
expr.surface: {typed}, maths keys with letters and powers
expr.marked: `rule: expr`/`eqn` by value at six points; a form question (simplify, factorise) matched as written
expr.tolerance: any equivalent form unless the form is the question

coords.label: Coordinates
coords.tolerance: exact; a graph reading as a band

graph.label: Plot a graph or chart
graph.tolerance: 0.3 of a square; a sketch by its shape

line.label: Draw a line or segment
line.tolerance: 0.3 of a square; ends snapped to the grid

shape.label: Draw a shape or transform one
shape.marked: draw_answer `segs` poly/`polygon`/`cuboid`; `or` for the right shape in the wrong place
shape.tolerance: corners within 0.3 of a square; any size where no scale

shade.label: Shade cells or a region
shade.tolerance: by the ink inside each cell

construct.label: Construct (compass and ruler)
construct.marked: draw_answer `curves` (arcs) with the line they make
construct.tolerance: arcs seen, the line within 0.3 of a square

choose1.label: Choose one
choose1.wrong: The tapped option red, the right one shown

chooseN.label: Choose several
chooseN.surface: The options as tiles; the count to pick is said

match.label: Match or sort into groups
match.surface: One box, every answer in order (owner, 13 Nov), or lines drawn on the figure in place (402)
match.marked: cells, each by markAnswer_; or draw_answer `join` (a stroke from one box to its partner)
match.tolerance: a cell holding a list is a set
match.phone: The keypad, answers parted by commas, lines or "and"

order.label: Put in order
order.surface: The items, and slots between the two ends (order_ends)
order.phone: Tap item, it takes the next slot

label.label: Label a diagram
label.surface: {pen}, or one box of every label in order
label.marked: cells (a label per place) or draw_answer `inside`; written labels are not read

table.label: Fill table cells
table.surface: The question's own table, its blanks as cells (359)
table.phone: Number pad where every way is a number

reason.label: Explanation or reasoning
tiles: AI (only when the rule cannot give every mark)
reason.marked: mark_words: the verdict and the figure that decides it, a point a mark; AI last
reason.tolerance: a No stopped by its own punctuation is the verdict
reason.wrong: n of m marks, the missing point not shown

words.label: Short words (1–2 marks)
words.marked: accept, else mark_words (key words, a point a mark); AI only after
words.tolerance: case, punctuation and a full stop ignored

essay.label: Essay
essay.surface: A sheet, word count under it
essay.marked: AI against the scheme (answer), clamped to the marks

hand.label: Set a hand or pointer
hand.marked: draw_answer `clock`/`dial`/`scale`, read as rays from the centre (368)
